messages:
mira: Quick sync 1: MedAssist wants to POC a new variant (Lacuna-16B-slim) for clinical triage + long-doc embeddings. Theyre PHI-heavy. Can we onboard and whats the timeline and cost ballpark for ~90M gen tokens + 6M embed tokens/mo?

sam: Lacuna-16B-slim not in our catalog today. We can onboard. Need model weights (HF or S3), tokenizer files, license info, ~1k representative prompts, max_context, and desired latency SLO. Also confirm whether embeddings will be stored and indexed.

oliver: From infra/ML: slim-> likely quantized Q4_K/Q5_K candidates. For long-docs we must validate KV cache and memory-per-token. If they need >16k context that changes GPU choice and perf tuning. I can run kernel sweep on A100/H100.

security: PHI => Requires Dedicated or Private with BAA. Need DPO contact, data flow diagram, confirmation on embeddings retention. For embeddings-with-PHI we mandate encrypted indices, KMS-managed keys, and audit logs. Legal timeline for addendum ~2-3 weeks.

price-bot: Pricing note: hosted list for that volume will be high. Options: (1) committed Dedicated capacity, (2) mixed routing: embeddings hosted, generation on Dedicated. Need peak concurrent streams and avg tokens/response to sketch compare.

mira: Customer asked: can validation be done in 5 business days after artifact handoff? Also asked for a short snippet to run tokenizer sanity checks.

sam: Basic tokenizer + smoke checks: 2-3 business days if artifacts clean. Full quality + safety eval: +2 days. If we need 32k context tuning: +3 days. So optimistic 5 days, realistic ~8 business days end-to-end. Legal (BAA) will likely be the blocker.

oliver: I can own perf sweep/quant candidates. Please provide a presigned S3 link (read-only). Ill run: 
```
# tokenizer roundtrip quick check
python -c "from transformers import AutoTokenizer; t=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('path/to/tokenizer'); s=open('samples.txt').read().splitlines()[:200]; ids=[t(x)['input_ids'] for x in s]; print(sum(len(i) for i in ids))"
```
and a tiny forward smoke test:
```
python -c "import torch; from model_loader import load; m=load('path/to/model'); x=torch.randint(0,32000,(1,128)); print(m(x).shape)"
```
These catch tokenizer mismatches and missing weights.

security: Also add requirement: if embeddings index PHI, customer must confirm retention policy and who can access indices. Add to questionnaire.

mira: Ill ask MedAssist for artifacts, 1k prompts, sample long-docs, peak concurrent streams and avg tokens. Also uploading their security questionnaire to deal binder.

price-bot: Once we have peak rps and avg sequence length Ill produce a hosted vs committed cost sketch.

deploy-bot: model-upload: artifact queued, awaiting checksum verification.

oliver: Note: if tokenizer uses custom special tokens, we may need an adapter step; flagging now.

mira: Thanks team. Ill schedule a customer sync for Friday and update the deal doc.
